acceptanceCriteria: QA finding F1 is fixed: starting 1 m or less from the 45 degree ramp at both walk and run speed, the capsule feet never rise above 0.3 m, while the 30 degree ramp, the 0.2 m step at walking speed and the 0.35 m step block all still behave as before; the root cause (autostep, STEP_PROBE, or both) is identified with evidence.

QA finding F2 is fixed: the ramp test asserts the peak feet height over the whole run from start positions at 0.5 m, 1 m and 2 m for walk and run, and the report shows the new test failing on the pre-fix code (red) and passing after the fix (green).

scripts/strip-clips.mjs reads the six FBX sources in assets-src/mixamo (Idle, Walking, Running, Jump, Falling Idle, Hard Landing) and writes rotation-only, Hips-free game clips idle, walk, run, jump, fall and land under public/game/clips, each under 100 KB, and clips.test.ts covers every produced file including a real GLTFLoader parse.

The new Walking and Running clips are measured for ground speed and loop period; the report states which walk and run sources ship (new or previous) and why, the curved Run Forward Arc Left is no longer the shipped run if the new Running is straight, and MOVEMENT walk and run speeds are retuned toward 2.2 and 4.8 m per second as far as the 0.75 to 1.8 playback clamp allows, with the resulting values recorded.

Jumping, walking off a ledge, and dropping from a height play take-off, a looping fall after the configured air-time threshold, and a hard landing on touchdown when the fall exceeded the hard-landing threshold (soft landing otherwise), with animator.test.ts covering every new transition and threshold; the idle clip is used when standing still.

ASSETS.md records each new source and shipped clip with source (Mixamo), the clip title, the provided-by-owner download date 2026-10-06, and the license note, and the superseded clips are either removed or marked unused.
